result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two pages are nearly identical: both have soft dark backgrounds, off-white body text, right-aligned monospace uptime figures and incident cards with clearly separated date, title and body. B wins narrowly. Its body text is slightly larger and its uptime figures are brighter. Its per-component 'Operational' labels add a clear metadata level. A's figures are dimmer gray, and its small footnote is a bit faint. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two pages are nearly the same: both use an off-black background, light text that doesn't glare, a monospace right-aligned uptime column and well-separated incident cards with date, title and body. A has a slightly softer body-text colour, a bit more line spacing and an 'Operational' status per component. B makes its secondary level clearer with uppercase section labels, but its uptime figures and footnote are a little dimmer and smaller. Neither difference is big enough to pick a winner.
